title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・ゴールはまだ先

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky runs her heart out and secures victory in the autumn Tenno Sho, delighting spectators and runners alike.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week is overjoyed to have had the chance to compete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her heart skips a beat when Maruzensky vows to continue running in order to have more fun races like this one.
